notes.title: 📢 Incoming Transmission from Resistance HQ...
notes.content:
Recruits! [b]Resistance Command[/b] has deployed a critical update. Whether you're climbing the leaderboards or sharpening your skills in the field, [b]v0.4.3[/b] brings new tech, improved visuals, and vital fixes based on community intel.

[h2]🆕 New Features[/h2] [list]
[*][b]Custom Leaderboard Names (LBE Only):[/b] Operators in Location-Based Entertainment mode can now enter custom leaderboard names—no more Steam handles on display. [i](Note: Not available for home use.)[/i]
[/list]
[h2]⚙ Improvements from Engineering Corps[/h2][list]
[*][b]RPG Overhaul:[/b][list]
    [*]Projectile impacts now respect line of sight.
    [*]Damage scales with distance from the blast centre.[/list][*][b]Hitscan Visuals:[/b][list]
    [*]Bullet trails now properly reflect the instant-hit nature of your weapons.[/list][*][b]Updated Game Description:[/b][list]
    [*]Clearer comms! The game now explicitly states it's designed for stationary play.[/list][*][b]Laser Sight Upgrade:[/b][list]
    [*]Every weapon now includes a laser pointer.
    [*]A laser dot has been added for better aiming precision.[/list][/list]
[h2]🗺 Map Changes & Base Upgrades[/h2][list]
[*][b]Visual Clarity:[/b][list]
    [*]Outline shader tweaks improve visibility across all maps.[/list][*][b]Alpha Base Environmental Update:[/b][list]
    [*]Made a minor visual tweak to background props to enhance immersion—keen-eyed recruits may spot the difference.[/list][*][b]Bravo Base Adjustments:[/b][list]
    [*]Starting tower walls lowered for clearer sightlines.
    [*]Excessive lighting removed to reduce glare on sniper scopes.[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333749/d74f408e89157fe15ddf2d91bcee36d88202c966.png[/img]
[h2]🐞 Bug Fixes from Tech Support[/h2][list][*][b]Executable Name:[/b][list]
    [*]File now properly named “Warranty Not Included.exe.”[/list][*][b]Leaderboard Ranks:[/b][list]
    [*]Fixed issue where retries showed incorrect placement.[/list][*][b]Zero Score Reporting:[/b][list]
    [*]You’ll now be listed as “Unrankable” if no targets were hit, instead of showing an arbitrary rank.[/list][*][b]RPG Collision & Reloading:[/b][list]
    [*]Impact detection fixed across all bases.
    [*]RPGs can no longer fire before finishing reload.[/list][/list]
[h2]⚖ Balance Changes – Weapon Division Report[/h2][list]
[*][b]Shotgun Reload Speed:[/b][list]
    [*]This underrated beast is now faster and deadlier.[list]
        [*][b]Previous Reload Time:[/b] 5.000 seconds
        [*][b]New Reload Time:[/b] 3.383 seconds[/list][*]That’s over [b]32.34% faster[/b]—give it another go and rain shells like a pro.[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333749/8453689315ec68e2513cc2ca6d17ecccf451128f.gif[/img]
[h2]⚠ Known Issues (On the Radar)[/h2][list]
[*][b]Leaderboard UI Lock-Up:[/b][list]
    [*]Minimising the leaderboard can cause it to freeze. If this happens, a restart is required.
    [*]Status: Under investigation—UI overhaul in the works![/list][/list]
[h2]💬 From the Frontline – Community Intel[/h2]
Thanks to all of you reporting bugs, sharing strategies, and helping us improve the game. Your feedback is powering the resistance!

[h2]Want to help shape future updates?[/h2]
🔗 Join the fight on [url=https://discord.gg/caVGQxAVjx]Discord[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3012350]Steam[/url]!

🪖 Stay sharp, soldier. The resistance is counting on you.
[i]- Boss Johnson[/i]

notes.title: Alpha Base
notes.content:
Recruits, the fight has begun! [b]Alpha Base[/b] plays a critical role in our mission to reclaim control. Hidden deep in the desert, this abandoned military base is the perfect location to train and refine your reflexes.

[b]Mission Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] Face a sequence of [b]24 randomised pop-up targets[/b], designed to test your speed and precision under pressure. Each successful hit triggers the next—can you keep up?[/list]Alpha Base offers endless opportunities for mastery. Compete for the highest scores on the [b]global leaderboards[/b] and prove you’re an asset to the resistance.

🔗 Already in the fight? Share your best Alpha Base scores on Discord and Steam!
